title: Reuse manifest entries only for fresh pages unmodified in this run
context: Full wiki regens rewrite every page, but the manifest logic reused prior entries for pages marked 'fresh', recording stale bytes against newly-written content. This corrupted hand-edit detection—hunch wiki --check fired immediately after hunch wiki, falsely accusing Hunch of hand-editing its own output.
decision: Manifest entries are now reused only when a page is marked 'fresh' AND wasn't actually written in this run (detected by absence from bytesByPage). Original generation timestamps are preserved on rewrites to maintain byte-idempotency across runs.
consequences: Hand-edit tripwire fires only on actual manual edits, not on Hunch-generated content
Full wiki regens remain byte-identical in git, preserving idempotency
hunch wiki --check no longer produces false positives immediately after a successful regen
alternatives_rejected: Never reuse prior entries (breaks byte-idempotency across runs)
Always reuse for fresh pages (original bug—indistinguishable from actual hand edits)
Track write status separately (adds metadata coupling; wastes space)
